headline: Training and Development Specialist
summary: Training and development specialist with five years building programs for bank and cooperative employees in Zamboanga del Norte. I design curricula, write e-learning modules, run workshops for adults and measure whether training actually changes performance. I work closely with managers to find the real skill gaps.

experience.title: Training and Development Specialist
bullets: Design and run onboarding, teller and credit training for 220 employees across 14 branches.
Built a 12-module e-learning course on anti-money-laundering rules, completed by every employee.
Measure training results against branch audit findings and service scores, and report them to management.

experience.title: Training Officer
bullets: Facilitated leadership and bookkeeping seminars for cooperative officers.
Wrote participant guides and pre- and post-tests for each seminar.
